card.name: Just before retinoid drug names
card.fires_on: The word or space just before a retinoid name such as acitretin, etretinate, tretinoin or retinoic acid. It fires on small words like of, with, receiving, including, an opening parenthesis, or a space.

modes.label: Linking word before retinoid
modes.description: A small word like of, with, receiving or including right before acitretin or another retinoid is named.
modes.example: Acitretin is a metabolite<< of>> etretinate (TEGISON),

modes.label: Parenthesis after retinoid name
modes.description: An opening parenthesis following tretinoin or retinoic acid, in interaction lists or trial text.
modes.example: Ponatinib Ruxolitinib Sonidegib Tretinoin<< (>>oral) Vandetanib a Monitor

modes.label: Space before a retinoid
modes.description: A bare space after a dose list, where the next word is likely a retinoid.
modes.example: rabbits, mice, and rats at oral doses of 0.6, 3, and<< >>15 mg per kg, respectively.

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with word pieces starting with "ret", as in retinoid names.
card.plain: It lights up where a retinoid drug name such as acitretin or tretinoin is about to appear or has just appeared.
